name: researcher
description: Research plugin with evidence gathering, source evaluation, citation, and synthesis workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Research questions with evidence, citations, and uncertainty notes.
interface.longDescription: Researcher provides an evidence-first workflow for gathering reliable sources, comparing claims, citing support, synthesizing conclusions, and identifying uncertainty or source gaps.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic and cite sources.
Compare the evidence for these options.
Summarize what is known and what remains uncertain.
